reviewSamples.author: Jennifer Castro
reviewSamples.text: I had a great experience with South Beach Locksmith & Security Systems. They helped me upgrade my home locks and install a security system. The team was prompt, knowledgeable, and very professional. Excellent service at a fair price, I highly recommend them for security needs!

reviewSamples.author: Timothy Fernandez
reviewSamples.text: I called South Beach Locksmith & Security Systems for help with a jammed sliding door lock. The technician quickly diagnosed and fixed the issue. He was courteous and professional, and the door works perfectly now. Pricing was reasonable. I'm very satisfied and would definitely use their services again.

reviewSamples.author: Abigaelle Ariste
reviewSamples.text: I called South Beach Locksmith & Security Systems during an emergency lockout. They arrived faster than expected, unlocked my apartment door smoothly, and didn't overcharge me. Technician was polite, helpful, and efficient. I highly recommend their locksmith and security services.

reviewSamples.author: Caden Bolding
reviewSamples.text: South Beach Locksmith did an outstanding job rekeying all my rental properties. The technician was punctual, organized, and got it done in less time than expected. I appreciate their attention to detail and reasonable pricing. Makes my job as a landlord much easier. Great local service I can trust.

reviewSamples.author: GALIH BHANU NUGRAHA
reviewSamples.text: After a break-in attempt, I called them for emergency lock replacement. They were at my place in less than an hour and reinforced the door too. Super respectful and efficient. The peace of mind was worth every penny. I'll be recommending them to everyone in my building.

research_notes: Google Maps (3 metodos de scraping Playwright distintos: gmaps_detail.js, gmaps_photocycle.js, gmaps_detail2.js con captura de red + click en 'See photos' + scroll extendido, y acceso por place_id) confirma de forma consistente que, de las 8 fotos que Maps reporta en el contador, solo 4 son imagenes con contenido distinto (verificado por hash MD5 de los bytes descargados); las demas son la misma imagen servida bajo URLs firmadas distintas (coincide con el patron de duplicacion tambien visto en las reseñas, que la UI de Maps repite tras el scroll). No se encontro Instagram, Facebook, Yelp, Nextdoor ni Google Local Services Ads para este telefono/direccion exactos (WebSearch con varias consultas). No tiene website propio: el boton de la ficha dice 'Add website' y ningun dominio candidato (incluyendo el que SI resuelve, southbeachlocksmith.com, que da 503 y no muestra nombre/direccion coincidentes) corresponde a este negocio verificado.
failed_reason: Solo 4 fotos reales y distintas verificables (Google Maps es la unica fuente publica: sin IG, sin Facebook, sin website propio). Por debajo del minimo de 5 fotos reales utilizables exigido por el pipeline tras esfuerzo razonable (3 metodos de scraping distintos sobre Maps + busquedas web dirigidas por telefono y direccion exacta).
